[SWS_Fr_00191] ⌈The function Fr_AbortCommunication() shall perform the fol-
lowing tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:
• Invoke the CC CHI command ’FREEZE’, which immediately aborts communica-
tion (if active) and changes to the POC:halt state from any previous POCState.
• Return E_OK.
⌋
Note: The function Fr_AbortCommunication() leaves the CC Fr_CtrlIdx in POC-
State POC:halt (vPOC!Freeze is set).
